proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s A B X H h hX hH hperp
  have hO : s.center ∈ line[ℝ, A, B] := h.wbtw.mem_affineSpan
  have hsub : H -ᵥ s.center ∈ (line[ℝ, A, B]).direction := AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction hH hO
  rw [direction_affineSpan, mem_vectorSpan_pair_rev] at hsub
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hsub
  have hin : inner ℝ (X -ᵥ H) (H -ᵥ s.center) = 0 := by
    rw [← hk, inner_smul_right, hperp, mul_zero]
  have hpy : dist X s.center ^ 2 = dist X H ^ 2 + dist H s.center ^ 2 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V X s.center, dist_eq_norm_vsub V X H, dist_eq_norm_vsub V H s.center, ← vsub_add_vsub_cancel X H s.center, norm_add_sq_real, hin]
    ring
  have hp := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.mul_dist_eq_abs_power hH h.left_mem h.right_mem
  have hXr : dist X s.center = s.radius := hX
  rw [hp, EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.power, abs_of_nonpos]
  · rw [hXr] at hpy; linarith
  · rw [hXr] at hpy; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (dist X H)]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B X H : P), s.IsDiameter A B → X ∈ s → H ∈ line[ℝ, A, B] → inner ℝ (X -ᵥ H) (B -ᵥ A) = 0 → dist X H ^ 2 = dist H A * dist H B
